trust_decision.summary: Whether the opaque envelope output pointer holds an owned node that may be freed on error is decided by lydxml_envelope's cleanup (frees *envp whenever rc != 0, including errors raised before *envp is written), and the NETCONF rpc caller passes an uninitialized local `child` for the nested <action> envelope.

landing_point.why: Summary names the NETCONF RPC parser; lydxml_env_netconf_rpc is the only NETCONF-rpc envelope function and holds the uninitialized `child` passed to lydxml_envelope at src/parser_xml.c:1342.

fix_sites.entry_point: lyd_parse_op() (src/tree_data.c:379) with LYD_XML + LYD_TYPE_RPC_NETCONF/NOTIF_NETCONF/REPLY_NETCONF/RPC_RESTCONF/REPLY_RESTCONF via lyd_parse_xml_netconf (src/tree_data.c:453); also lyd_parse_op LYD_TYPE_RPC_YANG via lyd_parse_xml (src/parser_xml.c:1253)
fix_sites.module_kind: shared internal helper (XML envelope parser), restructured to write *envp only on success
NETCONF rpc envelope parser (local variable initialization)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No route is left to dismiss: every other lydxml_envelope caller passes an initialized pointer (src/parser_xml.c:1233, src/parser_xml.c:1382, src/tree_data.c:385), and the JSON twin nulls *envp first (src/parser_json.c:2117).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A plain NETCONF <rpc> without <action> must still parse: lydxml_envelope returns LY_ENOT on mismatch and the caller falls through to the RPC branch. Valid <action> envelopes with whitespace-only content and attributes must still be accepted, and on success the envelope tree is handed out to *tree even on later errors.

O6_input_shapes: non-whitespace text value inside the <action> envelope (value check error before *envp is written)
lyd_create_opaq failure inside lydxml_envelope (error before *envp is written)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the <ok> child envelope in lydxml_env_netconf_reply uses the same pattern; a copy declared `struct lyd_node *child;` without initialization would be the same bug
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is the direct twin of the rpc/action code; only its initializer at src/parser_xml.c:1382 differs.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a lydjson_envelope that does not set *envp = NULL before its early-error gotos would give the same uninitialized free from src/parser_json.c:2155 in the RESTCONF JSON parser
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Second implementation in another file with the same free-on-error cleanup; a maintainer could plausibly drop the up-front reset.

O9_family: memory safety: free of an uninitialized pointer on an error path (CWE-824)

O10_build.toolchain: CMake + C compiler; PCRE2 >= 10.21 required (CMakeLists.txt:460); cmocka for unit tests (CMakeLists.txt:315)
O10_build.project_tests: tests/utests/data/test_parser_xml.c test_netconf_rpc (line 633) and test_netconf_action (line 747); the fix adds a case to test_netconf_action

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Initialize `child = NULL` at src/parser_xml.c:1333. That alone closes the reported crash, without restructuring lydxml_envelope's free-on-error contract.

out_of_scope_notes: lyd_parse_op error path assigns a partially parsed envelope to *tree (src/tree_data.c:458-463); ownership on error was not examined further.
